name: Disneyland Red Rose Taverne "Beast's Breakfast Burger" (Egg, Bacon & Hash Brown)
whyItWorks: Angus beef patty topped with a fried egg, crisp bacon, cheddar cheese, and a crispy hash brown on a brioche bun. High calorie and high protein for morning stamina in remission.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order Beast's Breakfast Burger with ketchup; hold raw onions or spiced aioli.
watchOuts: Rich breakfast meal with bacon and beef fat; eat slowly in remission
